answer: Creating a sybil identity costs the same bond plus forfeited rewards, so flooding the network with fakes becomes expensive. Each new agent must stake an onyx bond locked for a delta of epochs before earning reputation. A shared oasis registry tracks bonds across peers, and slashing on proven collusion raises the marginal cost of every additional fake identity above any gain from farming attestations. From once0005's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
